summary: Arizona State University's Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program has an open call: Phase III, Innovation and Technology, with 50 places for young African professionals on full-time ASU Online master's degrees, studied while living in Kigali, Rwanda. Applications close on Sunday 22 November at 23:59 GMT. The earlier call for on-campus study closed on 27 September 2026.
meta_title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars at ASU: 50 places, apply by 22 Nov
meta_description: ASU's Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program offers 50 online master's places for young Africans, based in Kigali, Rwanda. Apply by 22 November 2026.
covers: Full tuition, housing and healthcare coverage while you study in Kigali.
Required books and student fees, transport to and from Kigali, and medical support.
Visa application costs, an English test voucher if you need one, and an ASU graduate application fee waiver.
eligibility: Young African professionals. The page for this call lists no further criteria, so read its FAQ and flyer before you apply.
You must be willing to relocate to Kigali, Rwanda, for the whole programme.
The earlier on-campus call asked for applicants aged 18 to 33 with a bachelor's degree and no master's started. Do not assume the same rules apply here.
how_to_apply: Choose a full-time ASU Online programme: MS Business Analytics, MCS Computer Science, MS Engineering in Sustainable Engineering, MS Global Technology and Development, MS Information Technology or MS User Experience.
Read the FAQ and flyer linked from the official page.
Submit the online application by Sunday 22 November 2026, 23:59 GMT.
Questions go to the Kepler College ASU Scholars contact on the official page.
watch_out: This call is online study from Kigali, not a place on ASU's campus in Arizona.
Relocating to Kigali for the whole programme is required.
The earlier call told applicants not to pay ASU's application fee or an English test in advance, and this call also lists a fee waiver and a test voucher, so check the FAQ before paying for either.
costs: Books, student fees and transport to and from Kigali
Visa processing and an English test voucher, if required
documents: The online application form on the official page.
Anything the call's FAQ and flyer ask for.

faq.q: Is the ASU Mastercard Foundation scholarship still open?
faq.a: Yes, for Phase III: 50 ASU Online master's places studied from Kigali, Rwanda, closing on Sunday 22 November at 23:59 GMT. The earlier on-campus call closed on 27 September 2026.
Not in this call. Scholars take ASU Online degrees full time and must relocate to Kigali, Rwanda, for the programme.
